Delhi Police seeks removal of posts targeting PM Modi

Delhi Police has reportedly asked social media platforms to remove posts allegedly containing abusive content targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This action follows reports of an FIR being filed against X (formerly Twitter) for allegedly defamatory posts. Separately, a woman in Noida was booked for allegedly posting an objectionable video about the Prime Minister. The police are reportedly monitoring content regularly.
